label: EU-machinery-2023 Annex V

obligations.text: ANNEX V EU DECLARATION OF CONFORMITY AND EU DECLARATION OF INCORPORATION PART A EU declaration of conformity of machinery and related products No … ( 6 ) The EU declaration of conformity shall contain the following particulars:
In the event of partial application of harmonised standards or common specifications, the EU declaration of conformity shall specify the parts which were applied.
PART B EU declaration of incorporation of partly completed machinery No … ( 7 ) The declaration of incorporation shall contain the following particulars:
In the event of partial application of harmonised standards or common specifications, the EU declaration of incorporation shall specify the parts which were applied.
A statement that the partly completed machinery shall not be put into service until the final machinery into which it is to be incorporated has been declared in conformity with this Regulation.
